asks: Does each agent program's own account match the boundary?
answer: To find out per program, by a live check. A run of real work goes through the boundary, and the program's own account is compared with what the boundary saw, request by request, joined by the provider's request id. On 19 November 2026, with an ordinary inspecting proxy standing in for the boundary, the account of Claude Code 2.1.327 matched on every request: the same request id, model and token counts. No run has gone through Silo's own boundary yet, and Codex and the other programs are not checked yet. The check runs again for each new version a recipe pins. A program or version whose account does not match on every request of the run, or gives no request id, gets no check against its account, and the app says so.
